sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 39

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 39:1
items.html: The first is that the detaining and the limit and the coarseness come into the screen as one, and nothing at all can be discerned of the screen at a time when it is not included in coarseness, for then it does not exist at all.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 39:2
items.html: The second is the discernment of detaining in “potential” that is in the screen from Malchut of the Rosh [head].

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 39:3
items.html: The third is the discernment of detaining in “actuality” that is in the screen in Malchut of the Guf [body].

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 39:4
items.html: The fourth is the inclusion of the screen in the coarseness of the first three phases at the time of its ascent.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 39:5
items.html: The fifth is that the two operations — the rejection of the light from phase four and the clothing of the light in the first nine Sefirot — are both bound up with the screen. For just as it rejects the light from the last phase, so it binds and clothes the lights that are from her upward.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 39:6
items.html: The sixth is the coarseness of from below upward, which is renewed in the screen by reason of its ascent and its coming into Malchut of the Rosh [head].

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 39:7
items.html: The seventh is the coarseness of from above downward, which is renewed in the screen through the records that were included in it as it passed through the Sefirot of the Guf [body] at the time of its refining. (Inner Observation, Item 79)
